recipe.title: Crispy Buffalo Chicken Loaded Potato Bowl
recipe.summary: Crispy potatoes and buffalo chicken finished with smooth cottage-cheese ranch, cheddar, celery, and green onion.
recipe.story: This bowl has everything a loaded buffalo chicken plate should have: crisp potatoes, spicy chicken, creamy ranch, melted cheese, and fresh crunch.
ingredients: 4 ounces Realgood Foods Lightly Breaded Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Place the diced potatoes in the air-fryer basket. Lightly coat them with cooking spray and season with the garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Air-fry the potatoes for 12 to 15 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until browned and crispy.
Cook the chicken nuggets according to the air-fryer directions on the package. Cut the cooked chicken into bite-sized pieces and toss with the buffalo sauce.
Blend the cottage cheese, ranch seasoning, and water until completely smooth and pourable.
Place the crispy potatoes in a bowl. Add the buffalo chicken and sprinkle the cheddar over the hot chicken.
Spoon the blended cottage-cheese ranch over the bowl. Finish with the celery and green onion.
tips: Add the cottage-cheese ranch after cooking so it stays cool and creamy.
Nutrition varies by chicken, ranch seasoning, buffalo sauce, and cheddar brand.
